correctness.rationale: An independently reconstructed 24-vertex, 36-edge truncated-cube graph produces exactly 1092 simplices. Exact rational boundary ranks (23,133,242,124,20) give reduced H2=Q and H3=Q^6 only; mod-101 ranks agree. A 44-triangle oriented surface cycle has zero integral boundary and survives mod 101. Every one of 48 signed symmetries acts on that nonzero H2 class by the determinant. Signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces on all 1092 simplices yield the full ten-class H3 character; inner products with S4 irreducible characters give integral multiplicities 1,1,1. The checker was executed successfully from the intended packaged source; finite exhaustive enumeration fully covers the stated finite object.

value.rationale: The complete rational symmetry representation of the first natural mixed-dimensional Archimedean Rips wedge is not determined by its 1+6 Betti numbers. Its fully resolved S4 x C2 decomposition has three distinct irreducible constituents, a nontrivial determinant line in H2, a split 3-even/3-odd inversion profile in H3, and one full-group invariant rational H3 class. These are substantive equivariant invariants and determine rational homology dimensions of full-symmetry quotients, directly motivated by symmetric finite-metric topology.
